opening.argument: The offer is built around paid cryptocurrency packages and recruitment-based compensation: the speaker calls it “a binary compensation plan,” then describes a matching bonus that pays “4 generations down” with “unlimited width.” The trading-strategy slide adds extraordinary growth figures, showing package profit ranges reaching up to 45,400 euros for a short-term Tycoon strategy and up to 475,000 euros for a long-term Tycoon strategy. The presentation ends with a direct invitation to join a team and sign up through the supplied link, encouraging participation in the recruitment structure rather than careful scrutiny of the offer.

citations.quote: You see, this business is like a binary compensation plan
The power of the generational matching bonus is that it pays 4 generations down, but it pays unlimited width
